core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case (proof lines 5857-5865): since the assertion is local and an integral morphism is affine, the author assumes everything affine, so that the etale morphism U over X is described by an algebra and the base change by a tensor product.

Verify the condition (proof lines 5865-5873): in the affine situation the author produces the etale V over Y and the disjoint union decomposition with a morphism to U, using that the relevant algebra is integral over the base and that the fibre over the given point is finite.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the affine case using affineness of integral morphisms.
Construct the etale neighbourhood V of Y and the decomposition required by property (A).
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (A) for an integral morphism of schemes (statement lines 5851-5855, with property (A) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof reduces to the affine case using that integral morphisms are affine (proof lines 5857-5865) and then constructs the etale neighbourhood of the base together with the disjoint union decomposition required by the property (proof lines 5865-5873). The non-formal content is the affine construction, integrality replacing finiteness. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one construction.
